content: CloudFront+S3 cache strategy: hashed assets Cache-Control public,max-age=31536000,immutable; HTML no-cache or max-age=60; invalidate /* after every deploy (1 path, 1000 free paths/mo). CloudFront honors Cache-Control within min/max TTL. Invalidations take minutes to propagate. s3 sync --delete wipes bucket if build dir empty - guard before sync.
